name: guardrails-monitoring
description: Ongoing monitoring: keep watching the agent after approval, and watch the controls themselves.

agentHold.title: agent-hold
agentHold.description: While background agents run, hold each report; when the last finishes, deliver all reports together in one message.

agentNameStrip.title: agent-hold: drop agent names
agentNameStrip.description: Drop the name from an agent launch unless it must message others, because a named agent's report bypasses the hold.

agentHoldDir.title: agent-hold: state folder
agentHoldDir.description: Per-session hold state and the monthly event log. '~' is your home folder.

agentHoldTtlMinutes.title: agent-hold: give up after (minutes)
agentHoldTtlMinutes.description: An agent with no report after this long is dropped from the hold.

agentHoldGraceSeconds.title: agent-hold: grace (seconds)
agentHoldGraceSeconds.description: After an agent finishes, how long to wait for its report before your next prompt releases the hold with a warning.

agentHoldBlock.title: agent-hold: block reports
agentHoldBlock.description: Block held reports outright instead of answering them with one line. Claude Code then prints each blocked report in grey.

replyPolicy.title: reply-policy
replyPolicy.description: Check each final reply against a written policy and rewrite it with a second model when it breaks the rules. Warnings are kept word for word; /full-reply shows the original. Costs one extra model call per rewritten reply.

replyPolicyFile.title: reply-policy: policy file
replyPolicyFile.description: Your policy file. Empty uses the bundled policies/terse.md. See docs/CONTROLS.md for the phrases it must contain.

replyPolicyModel.title: reply-policy: rewrite model
replyPolicyModel.description: The model that rewrites a reply.

replyPolicyLogDir.title: reply-policy: log folder
replyPolicyLogDir.description: One JSON file per reply that broke the policy, for measuring violation rates. Empty turns logging off.

staleNumberFlag.title: stale-number-flag
staleNumberFlag.description: When a figure is saved to notes without a date, ask for the date it was checked.

notesPaths.title: stale-number-flag: notes paths
notesPaths.description: Comma-separated path fragments that mark a notes file (Markdown or text).

controlsWatchdog.title: controls-watchdog
controlsWatchdog.description: Add /guardrails-status, showing when each pack last loaded. Pair it with watchdog/controls-watchdog.mjs as a session-start hook, which runs outside the mod engine.

heartbeatDir.title: Heartbeat folder
heartbeatDir.description: Each pack writes <pack>.txt here at session start, read by /guardrails-status and the outside watchdog. '~' is your home folder. Empty turns it off.
